headline: President Trump signed an order changing which goods are covered by tariffs placed on imports from Brazil.
what_it_does: This executive order changes the scope of tariffs, which are taxes on imported goods, that the U.S. had placed in connection with the government of Brazil. Based on the title alone, it adjusts which products or situations the tariffs apply to. No summary was provided, so it is not clear whether the tariffs were widened or narrowed, or which goods are involved.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. businesses that import goods from Brazil
who_it_affects.how: The tariffs they pay on some Brazilian products may change.

who_it_affects.group: Brazilian exporters selling to the U.S.
who_it_affects.how: The tariffs their products face when entering the U.S. may change.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. consumers who buy Brazilian-made products
who_it_affects.how: Prices on some imported goods could shift depending on how the tariffs changed.
